_readme: Single source of truth for portfolio projects. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build.mjs` to regenerate all pages and the sitemap. Every text field is bilingual: { ar, en }. Set `placeholder: false` once a project shows your own work. `featured: true` shows the project on the homepage (first featured project appears largest). Image paths live under /assets/projects/<slug>/. `sourceId` is the Unsplash CDN id recorded for licensing â€” see assets/licenses/LICENSES.md.
